newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ thinks cannot easily raise key rate-LDP quoted.
newsitem.headline: BOJ thinks cannot easily raise key rate-LDP quoted.

text.p: The chairman of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party's policy-setting committee, Taku Yamazaki, was quoted by Jiji news agency as saying on Monday that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) seems to think that it cannot raise the official discount rate easily.

Jiji quoted Yamazaki as saying in a speech: "It is important to promote consumption by individuals. But I think there is a view among the BOJ's policy-makers that the bank cannot raise the discount rate easily, partly because of its consideration of capital spending."
"I think the BOJ will make a cautious decision (regarding a change in the discount rate)," Yamazaki was quoted as saying.
The discount rate has been pegged at a historic low of 0.5 percent since September 1995, partly in a bid to stimulate capital spending to ensure economic recovery.
